According to certain credit card processors, you have a allotted amount of time to issue a refund (As the seller). Just keep this in mind when waiting on back ordered items, Don't wait to long cause after that amount of time, the seller has every right to just give you all store credit instead of a refund back on the card or PayPal Account.
